Hi! I’m your voice assistant. Tap the microphone and say a command. Say “help” to hear what I can do.
Hello! How can I help you?
It is %1$s.
Today is %1$s.
Battery level is %1$d%%.
Battery level is %1$d%% and the phone is charging.
Opening the camera.
For how many minutes? Say, for example, “set a timer for 5 minutes”.
I can set a timer from 1 minute to 24 hours.
Searching the web for %1$s.
What should I search for? Say, for example, “search for funny cats”.
I can tell the time and date, check the battery, open the camera, set a timer and search the web. For example: “what time is it”, “set a timer for 5 minutes”, “search for funny cats”.
Sorry, I didn’t understand “%1$s”. Say “help” to see what I can do.
